spans.s:
झञ्झन n. (-नं) An indistinct noise, like the jangling of metallic orna-
ments, a ringing, a rattling, &c.

झञ्झा f. (-ञ्झा)
 1. Wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale.
 2. A sharp
clanging sound, jangling.
 3. Raining in large drops.
 4. A stray,
any thing lost. झमिति कृत्वा झटति झट-ड ।

झञ्झानिल m. (-लः) Wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season,
a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west
monsoon.
 E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and अनिल wind; also झञ्झा-
मरुत्, &c.

झञ्झावात m. (-तः) Wind with rain, a storm, a squall.
 E. झञ्झा heavy
rain, and वात wind.
